title: Tenders
description: Payment methods (tenders) accepted at the point of sale. The user chooses the tender type and how it is connected; Store Data adds every technical setting the point of sale needs (payment plugin, provider identifier, engine flags) before the tender is sent to the store. The 'id' field is the primary key — it must be unique within the array.

id.title: Tender ID
id.description: Unique identifier for this tender. Acts as the primary key — must be unique across all tenders and never reused. Referenced by transactions, reports and ERP integrations. Examples: 'CASH_EUR', 'VISA', 'SWISH'.

type.title: Tender Type
type.description: The kind of payment this tender is. Choose exactly one type; its own settings appear below it. The type decides how the point of sale handles the payment, including whether it can be cancelled or refunded.

oneOf.title: Cash
oneOf.description: Notes and coins handled at the till, in the local currency or, with 'Foreign Currency' set, in another currency.

oneOf.title: Credit / Debit Card
oneOf.description: Payment card read by a card terminal.

oneOf.title: Mobile Payment
oneOf.description: Payment with a mobile app such as Swish or Vipps.

oneOf.title: Electronic Gift Card
oneOf.description: Gift card with a balance held in a gift card system.

oneOf.title: Organization Charge
oneOf.description: Purchase charged to a business customer's account.

oneOf.title: Check
oneOf.description: Paper check.

oneOf.title: Gift Certificate
oneOf.description: Paper gift certificate with a fixed value.

oneOf.title: Voucher
oneOf.description: Voucher with a value, for example a credit note.

oneOf.title: Coupon
oneOf.description: Store coupon used as payment.

oneOf.title: Manufacturer Coupon
oneOf.description: Coupon issued by a manufacturer and used as payment.

oneOf.title: Loyalty Points Redemption
oneOf.description: Payment with loyalty points.

oneOf.title: House Account
oneOf.description: Purchase charged to a customer account held by the store.

oneOf.title: Food Stamp / SNAP
oneOf.description: Food stamp or SNAP benefit.

oneOf.title: WIC Check
oneOf.description: WIC benefit check.

name.title: Display Name
name.description: The name shown on the point of sale screen and printed on receipts. Examples: 'Cash', 'Visa / Mastercard', 'Swish'.

description.title: Description
description.description: An internal description for configuration reference. Not shown to cashiers or customers.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code of this tender, for example 'SEK' or 'EUR'. The currency must exist at the point of sale. The default cash tender's currency is the store's local currency. For a foreign currency cash tender, this is the foreign currency.

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.description: When true, the tender is removed from the point of sale but its configuration is kept, so it can be enabled again later.

restrictionRuleId.title: Item Restriction
restrictionRuleId.description: The id of an item restriction rule that limits which items can be paid with this tender. Restriction rules are configured separately and shared between tenders.

behavior.title: Point of Sale Behavior
behavior.description: Settings that control how the point of sale handles this tender during a transaction. Settings left unset use the default for the tender type.

isDefault.title: Default Tender of Its Type
isDefault.description: The point of sale uses the default tender of a type when no specific tender of that type is chosen, so each type needs exactly one default tender. Leave unset when the type has only one tender; it then becomes the default. When a type has several tenders, set exactly one to true; otherwise Store Data rejects the tender list. Foreign currency cash tenders count as a type of their own. The default cash tender, which is not a foreign currency tender, sets the store's local currency.

allowOverpayment.title: Allow Overpayment
allowOverpayment.description: When true, the customer can pay more than the amount due, and the difference is given back as change. Leave unset to use the default for the tender type.

openCashDrawer.title: Open Cash Drawer
openCashDrawer.description: When true, the cash drawer opens when a transaction is finalized with this tender. Leave unset to use the default for the tender type.

lockTransaction.title: Lock Transaction After Payment Entry
lockTransaction.description: When true, no more items can be added, changed or discounted once the cashier has entered this tender. The payment can still be completed or cancelled.

exclusive.title: No Split Payment
exclusive.description: When true, this tender cannot be combined with any other tender in the same transaction.

autoFinalize.title: Auto-Finalize Payment
autoFinalize.description: When true, the point of sale completes the payment with this tender without asking the cashier to confirm the amount. Intended for unmanned scenarios such as self-checkout. Not available for cash; a cash changer machine is finalized automatically.

change.title: Change
change.description: How change is given when the customer pays more than the amount due. Not used when the tender does not allow overpayment, either through 'Allow Overpayment' or the default for the tender type.

maxCashBack.title: Cash Back Auto-Finalize Limit
maxCashBack.description: Below this amount, change is completed automatically. At or above it, the cashier must complete it manually. It is a threshold, not a hard cap.

tenderId.title: Alternate Change Tender
tenderId.description: The id of another tender in the list, with a currency, used to give change instead of cash.

threshold.title: Change Threshold
threshold.description: Above this amount, change is given with the alternate change tender; at or below it, change is given in cash. Only used together with an alternate change tender.

refund.title: Refund Limits
refund.description: Limits for refunds with this tender. Whether the tender can be used for refunds follows from the tender type; for a type that cannot be refunded these limits are not used. A minimum must not be larger than the maximum.

maxAmount.title: Maximum Refund Amount
maxAmount.description: The largest amount that can be refunded with this tender in one refund. Leave unset for no limit.

minAmount.title: Minimum Refund Amount
minAmount.description: The smallest amount that can be refunded with this tender. Leave unset for no limit.

limits.title: Amount Limits
limits.description: Limits on how much can be paid with this tender. The point of sale checks them when the cashier enters the amount. Leave a limit unset for no limit. A minimum must not be larger than the maximum.

maxPerTransaction.title: Maximum per Transaction
maxPerTransaction.description: The largest amount that can be paid with this tender in one transaction.

minPerTransaction.title: Minimum per Transaction
minPerTransaction.description: The smallest amount that can be paid with this tender in one transaction.

maxPerRegistration.title: Maximum per Registration
maxPerRegistration.description: The largest amount for a single entry of this tender, independent of other entries of tenders in the same transaction.

rounding.title: Amount Rounding
rounding.description: Rounds the amount paid with this tender, typically for cash in currencies where the smallest coin is larger than the currency's minor unit. Leave empty for no rounding; method and precision are set together.

method.title: Rounding Method
method.description: How an amount between two units is rounded.

oneOf.title: Mathematical
oneOf.description: Round half up: an amount exactly in between is rounded up.

oneOf.title: Round Half Down
oneOf.description: An amount exactly in between is rounded down.

oneOf.title: Scientific
oneOf.description: Rounds to a multiple of the precision, always in one direction: down unless the point of sale is configured to round up. The direction for positive and negative amounts is set in the point of sale configuration, not on the tender.

precision.title: Rounding Precision
precision.description: The unit to round to. Examples: 0.05 rounds to the nearest 5 cents; 1.0 to the nearest whole unit.

extraAttributes.title: Extra Attributes
extraAttributes.description: Only use when instructed by Extenda Retail support. A name starting with 'Pos.' is an advanced point of sale setting from the documented list of tender properties, for example 'Pos.maximumPerTransaction.amountOverride'; Store Data checks the name and type. Any other name is passed to point of sale extensions as is. Each name may be used only once per tender.

type.title: Data Type
type.description: The data type of the value.

value.title: Value
value.description: Always written as text. Examples: 'true' for Boolean, '3.14' for a decimal number, '42' for a whole number.

allOf.title: Cash: auto-finalize is not available
allOf.description: The cashier handles notes and coins, so the amount must be confirmed. A cash changer machine is finalized automatically by Store Data.

allOf.title: Overpayment not allowed: no change settings
allOf.description: If the customer cannot pay more than the amount due, change never arises.

cash.title: Cash
cash.description: Notes and coins handled at the till, in the local currency or, with 'Foreign Currency' set, in another currency.

hardware.title: Cash Handling Hardware
hardware.description: The cash-handling device connected to the point of sale. 'Cash Changer Machine' counts and dispenses change automatically. 'Standard Cash Drawer' is opened by the point of sale but operated by the cashier.

oneOf.title: Standard Cash Drawer
oneOf.description: Opened by the point of sale, operated manually by the cashier.

oneOf.title: Cash Changer Machine
oneOf.description: Counts notes and coins and dispenses change automatically. The till must also have the cash changer enabled in its peripheral settings.

foreignCurrency.title: Foreign Currency
foreignCurrency.description: When true, this tender accepts cash in another currency than the store's own, set in 'Currency'. The point of sale converts the amount due with the exchange rate for that currency; an exchange rate for the currency must exist. Foreign currency tenders have their own default tender, separate from local cash.

creditDebit.title: Credit / Debit Card
creditDebit.description: Payment card read by a card terminal.

integration.title: Card Terminal Integration
integration.description: How the card terminal connects to the point of sale. 'Integrated' means the point of sale sends the amount to the terminal automatically. 'Standalone' means the cashier types the amount on a separate, unconnected terminal.

oneOf.title: Integrated — Cloud
oneOf.description: The terminal communicates with the point of sale through the cloud. Requires internet access.

oneOf.title: Integrated — Local
oneOf.description: The terminal communicates with the point of sale over the local network.

oneOf.title: Standalone
oneOf.description: Separate terminal with no connection to the point of sale. The cashier enters the amount manually.

provider.title: Card Payment Provider
provider.description: The payment service provider for the integrated card terminal. Informational: the provider itself is configured in the payment connector. Not applicable to standalone terminals.

mobile.title: Mobile Payment
mobile.description: Payment with a mobile app such as Swish or Vipps.

integration.title: Mobile Payment Integration
integration.description: How the mobile payment is processed. 'Integrated' means the point of sale sends the payment request to the customer's app. 'Standalone' means a separate terminal is used.

oneOf.title: Integrated
oneOf.description: The point of sale sends the payment request directly to the customer's app.

oneOf.title: Standalone
oneOf.description: Separate terminal with no connection to the point of sale.

provider.title: Mobile Payment Provider
provider.description: The mobile payment service. Not applicable to standalone payments.

electronicGiftCard.title: Electronic Gift Card
electronicGiftCard.description: Gift card with a balance held in a gift card system.

integration.title: Gift Card Integration
integration.description: How the gift card is authorized at the point of sale.

oneOf.title: Integrated
oneOf.description: The point of sale checks the balance online and authorizes the payment through the gift card plugin.

oneOf.title: Standalone
oneOf.description: The card is read locally by legacy card-reader hardware, with no online authorization.

organizationCharge.title: Organization Charge
organizationCharge.description: Purchase charged to a business customer's account.

accountAuthorization.title: Verify Business Account
accountAuthorization.description: When true, the point of sale verifies that the customer has a registered business account with enough credit before accepting this tender.

giftCertificate.title: Gift Certificate
giftCertificate.description: Paper gift certificate with a fixed value.

voucher.title: Voucher
voucher.description: Voucher with a value, for example a credit note.

manufacturerCoupon.title: Manufacturer Coupon
manufacturerCoupon.description: Coupon issued by a manufacturer and used as payment.

houseAccount.title: House Account
houseAccount.description: Purchase charged to a customer account held by the store.
